rows.text: A set of dice, carved from human bones. Counts as a lucky charm.
Bejewelled Dagger. Can be sold for 15gc.
Ornate Key. Can be discarded after making an exploration roll to modify the value of an exploration die.
Rusty Ostlander Sword, notched from use.
Sack of teeth. The fillings can be sold for d3x10 gold coins.
Waxed parchment map, half burned away. Find another to make a Mordheim Map.
A battered Cuirass. With a little elbow grease, it'll count as light armour.
A Wyrdstone Shard, ice cold to the touch.
Noble Signet Ring. Can be handed over to your faction for 1 Favour or sold for 20gc.
Rare find. Roll once on the Greater Loot Table.
An iron lockbox containing D3 Wyrdstone Shards.
Magical Item. Roll a d6 to determine which one.
